mapper.select: select al.id, al.actor_type as actorType, al.actor_user_id as actorUserId, al.subject_type as subjectType, al.subject_id as subjectId, al.action, cast(al.before_data as char) as beforeData, cast(al.after_data as char) as afterData, al.reason, al.created_at as createdAt, su.user_name as actorUserName, su.nick_name as actorNickName, case when al.actor_type = 'staff' then coalesce(su.nick_name, su.user_name, al.actor_user_id) when al.actor_type = 'system' then 'system' else al.actor_user_id end as actorDisplayName from cm_audit_logs al left join sys_user su on al.actor_type = 'staff' and cast(al.actor_user_id as unsigned) = su.user_id where al.id = #{id} limit 1
